k2_support_bounds._rationale: Physical-k2 support guard, IDENTICAL box to titan_freegrav_noocean.json and test54_titan_nh3_freegrav.json (scientific-reviewer a2d7f121). Fluid-limit secular Love ceiling k2<=3/2 => Re_k2 in [-0.1,1.5]; dissipation cannot exceed elastic response => |Im_k2| in [0,1.0]. Applied to the NOISELESS forward output before obs noise (imag_convention='abs' globally), counted as a support rejection so SBI training support == reference-MCMC effective support. Physics-anchored, NOT tuned to pass. In the JOINT posterior this box ADMITS frozen no-ocean nodes into the likelihood-disfavored low-k2 tail rather than support-rejecting them.

metadata.description: Titan free-gravity SBI campaign, NaCl-ocean interior model, Phase B of the Titan free-gravity plan (plans/fluffy-snacking-fountain.md). JOINT no-ocean + ocean posterior (same mechanism as the ratified NH3 artifact test54_titan_nh3_freegrav.json, Task #68): the (Tb, w) plane is a steeply TILTED band whose ocean stripe slides ~40 K down as salinity rises. Frozen (cold/dilute) nodes build as REAL no-ocean interiors (retry_frozen_as_no_ocean=True; do_overrides NO_OCEAN_EXCEPT_INNER_ICES=True, comp='NaCl' kept so the salted liquidus still sets the HP-ice temperature profile) and appear in the posterior; the warm/high-w no-ice-lid corner is stored None (correctly excluded). Interior priors, derived rho_sil (mass conservation), rheology/thermal parameter space, gravity channel, and observable vector are IDENTICAL to titan_freegrav_noocean.json and the NH3 joint config (reviewer action item 3: consistent dissipation across no-ocean and all ocean configs). Differences vs NH3: (1) comp='NaCl', (2) Tb_K widened to the NaCl union-sweep [233,272] K (the achievable diagonal across the full salinity axis), (3) log10_wOcean_ppt upper bound capped at log10(290)=2.4624 (NaCl SeaFreeze wMax=290.3 ppt, acc725ea R3), (4) a NaCl 2D (Tb x w) structure cache replaces the NH3 one, (5) phase_stability.enforce DROPPED (admits both regimes).
metadata.reference: Petricca et al. (2025), Nature 648:558 (gravity C20/C22, k2, MoI); interior parameterization from test52 (Yao 2014 spherical Ih convection, Kalousova HP convection, Arrhenius viscosity, Andrade rheology). NaCl ocean EOS via SeaFreeze NaClaq; conductivity via Pan et al. (2021) NaClConductPan2021.

salinity_axis_2026_08_06.ceiling_rationale: NaCl SeaFreeze EOS wMax=290.3 ppt (7 mol/kg H2O). acc725ea R3 (reviewer, 2026-07-27): cap log10_wOcean_ppt upper at log10(290)=2.4624, NOT the naive 300 ppt (2.477) which exceeds the EOS domain. Campaign spec lower limit 1 ppt. Prior uniform in log10 w (Jeffreys).

metadata.phase_stability_dropped_reason: phase_stability.enforce is NOT set (contrast titan_freegrav_noocean.json 'no_ocean_Ih'). Omitting it admits BOTH the frozen no-ocean regime and the ocean regime into the joint posterior (there is no default 'must-have-ocean' guard). density_inversion_guard (on rho_sil) and k2_support_bounds still apply uniformly (physical training-set hygiene).

joint_build_2026_08_06.extrap_ocean: True — effective NO-OP for NaCl (reviewer Item-1, 2026-08-06): HydroEOS truncates NaCl Pmax at 1000.1 MPa UNCONDITIONALLY and the ocean-property interpolants are RectBivariateSpline (flat-extrapolation), so extrap_ocean True==False to machine precision above 1000.1 MPa. NOT a genuine EOS extrapolation (unlike MgSO4 whose density table Pmax=800 MPa < basal P). Frozen no-ocean columns fill depth with SeaFreeze ice VI (Pmax ~2300 MPa), in-domain.
